title: Check a supplied rectangular section
scenario: The dimensions and supplied steel illustrate the same section as the linked reference case. Resolve rule/data identity before execution. Reference expected PASS is not a new C# result.

title: Design required steel
scenario: Design an ordinary section for the supplied 130 kNm ULS moment. Report required area; bar fit remains outside this first schema.

title: Reject a missing or impossible structural input
scenario: Check mode without supplied steel fails schema validation; d greater than D fails semantic validation.

title: Analyze a simply supported span
scenario: A 6000 mm prismatic span has a full-span 12 kN/m characteristic UDL, with self-weight explicitly included by the user. Derive selected ULS/SLS combinations, reactions and station vectors using a separately verified solver. No numeric result is asserted here.

title: Design a complete ordinary member
scenario: Use the concurrent actions from EX04, declared material/cover/bar catalogue and service profile. Select bars and links, recompute depths and check every required station. Iterate or report no feasible arrangement.

title: Check an existing member
scenario: Supply actual bar coordinates, diameters, links, supports and actions. Preserve bars even when capacity fails; show suggested redesign only as a separate operation.

title: Produce a resolved arrangement
scenario: Take a current member result and actual support geometry. Resolve anchorage/laps, marks and link zones; unresolved cutoff or support details prevent an issued BBS.

title: Export a diagnostic and issued report
scenario: An incomplete run can produce a labeled draft report. An issued complete-design package requires all profile-required checks, current identity and resolved drawings/schedule.
